records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Studio!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Your workspace for Silver Studio is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Following up on the mobile save button
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks again for flagging that the mobile view cuts off the save button -- that ticket is still open on our side and I'm staying on it until you have an answer.

In the meantime, I don't want it holding up the work itself. You've got a real project started and a teammate invited, which is the right foundation -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your team's actual tasks in alongside you, and I can share where the mobile issue stands.

Best,
Nadia
